is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 4, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the kdr gene (Vgsc L995F/S) in Anopheles gambiae (page 3, Molecular assays; page 6, Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on page 6 provides the number of kdr alleles and total alleles for both alive and dead mosquitoes across different treatments.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Akron, Benin, using field-collected mosquitoes (page 2, Study site and experimental huts).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial conducted by the authors (page 1, Abstract).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Akron, a village on the periphery of Porto Novo, Benin (page 2, Study site and experimental huts).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between June and September 2010 (page 3, Insecticide treatments).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a specific experimental hut trial conducted in 2010.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of combining chlorfenapyr IRS with pyrethroid-treated LLINs against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae in experimental huts in Benin. It also genotyped mosquitoes for kdr resistance to assess if the combination treatment selected for resistance.
